summary.intent: Run the GSD Manager to drive the remaining 3 phases of a nearly-complete milestone (v1.1, 93% done), starting with discussing Phase 56 (FUSE and IPNS Durability Hardening) to lock design decisions before planning/execution.
summary.outcome: Phase 56 discussion completed with all key decisions locked (failure-surfacing policy and CAS-retry structure). CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md written and staged, but the commit failed due to a 1Password SSH signing error.

repo: Phase 56 closes 12 pre-existing gaps from PR #538 review — pure behavior-correctness, no new capabilities. Scope sourced from 4 named todos folded into the phase.

IPNS Conflict handling is scattered and inconsistent: folder publish (metadata.rs:136–214) already has correct re-resolve+retry; per-file (content_ops.rs:167) and bin (metadata.rs:340) swallow Conflict as success — these are the bugs.
mkdir.rs and platform/windows/write_ops.rs use a separate event-channel re-arm (MkdirConflict) that is platform-duplicated and intentionally left untouched by Phase 56.
winfsp is CI-only on macOS — local cargo never builds windows/*; macOS and Windows paths must change in lockstep and the Windows CI gate is authoritative.
Zeroization rule: a callee must NOT zero a caller-owned/reused buffer; only the terminal owner zeroes. The createAndPublishIpnsRecord regression broke 48/89 SDK E2E by violating this.
Phase 43/46 established a persisted out-of-callback pending-upload journal with crash-replay — this is the durability substrate Phase 56 enqueues exhausted retries into.

code.finding: Folder publish already has the correct bounded re-resolve+retry loop for IPNS Conflict — this is the reference implementation to extract into a shared helper.
Per-file IPNS publish swallows Conflict as success — bug targeted by Phase 56 Plan 1.
Bin IPNS publish swallows Conflict as success — bug targeted by Phase 56 Plan 2.

workflow: GSD discuss-phase routes through discuss-phase.md, scouts codebase for reusable assets, surfaces gray areas interactively, then writes CONTEXT.md with locked decisions for downstream planner/executor.
Commits require GPG/SSH signing via 1Password biometric — the signing agent can return 'failed to write commit object' if the biometric prompt times out or is not approved in time; retry is safe.
The commit helper has a known false-negative behavior (appears to succeed but no commit lands); always verify with git log after committing.

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent returned 'failed to write commit object' — the Phase 56 docs commit did not land despite files being correctly staged. Required manual retry.
Commit ran in background (unsandboxed) and hung waiting on biometric approval with no inline feedback, making it hard to distinguish a wedged signer from normal latency.
Pre-existing Cargo.lock modification was present in the working tree and had to be consciously excluded from the phase 56 commit scope.
open_items: Phase 56 commit is still pending/failing — needs confirmation that the signed commit lands before phase can advance to planning.
Phase 57 (API CID and Provider Hardening and Module Dedup) is unblocked and needs discussion next.
Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) is blocked on Phase 56 completing — can only be discussed after Phase 56 is at least in 'discussed' state.
The shared publish_with_cas_retry Rust helper needs to be extracted from metadata.rs:136–214 and wired into content_ops.rs:167 and metadata.rs:340 during Phase 56 execution.
